svg.title: Map of California's North Coast with seven numbered stops: Muir Woods north of San Francisco, a roadside stop near Napa, St. Helena, the Petrified Forest near Calistoga, Goat Rock on the Sonoma Coast, the coast south of Mendocino, and Glass Beach at Fort Bragg.
